steps: Peel and grate 2 Pears; squeeze out excess juice with your hands.
In a large bowl, whisk 2 Eggs with Ricotta and Vanilla extract until smooth.
Add Rice flour, Baking powder, and Cinnamon; stir until a thick batter forms.
Fold in the grated Pear until evenly distributed.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat, 180 °C (350 °F), and brush with Canola oil.
Drop heaped tablespoons of batter into the skillet; flatten gently with the back of a spoon.
Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side, until golden and set through with no wet centre.
Transfer to a wire rack; repeat with remaining batter. Serve warm or at room temperature.
Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days; reheat in a dry pan if desired.
